summary: Iteration 13: Testing drag-and-drop functionality for categories and options in Balia and Sauna admin panels. All core drag-and-drop features are working correctly using @dnd-kit library.
critical_code_review_comments: GripVertical icons (6-dot pattern) are visible on the left side of each draggable item
cursor-grab class applied to drag handles for proper cursor feedback
handleReorderCategories and handleReorderOptions functions correctly update state
sortOrder is updated for all items after drag operation
BaliaPricingPage uses SortableList for both categories and options
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - using existing prices data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag-and-drop feature verified working: 1) GripVertical icons visible on left side of categories and options, 2) Categories can be dragged to reorder in both Balia and Sauna admin panels, 3) Options within categories have drag handles (displayed in 2-column grid), 4) 'Zapisz wszystko' button saves the new order, 5) Order persists after page reload/re-login
